title: Best Software Companies Hiring Remote QA Engineers in 2026
meta_description: 626 companies are hiring remote QA engineers and testers right now. See who has the most open remote QA, SDET and automation jobs. Updated November 11, 2026.
content:
Updated November 11, 2026. Data from 1,020 open QA and software testing jobs we track every day.

Looking for a QA, SDET or software testing job you can do from home? Below are the software companies with the most open remote QA roles right now, ranked by live job count. Unlike generic "best places to work" lists, this page is rebuilt from real job posts, so every company on it is hiring testers today.

Remote QA hiring at a glance (November 2026)

  • 935 of 1,020 open QA jobs are remote (91.7%).
  • 626 companies are hiring remote QA engineers and testers.
  • 204 new QA jobs were posted in the last 7 days.
  • Median advertised QA salary: $110k per year (USD equivalent, 18.8% of posts show pay).
  • Most requested tools: Selenium (29.9%), Playwright (27.0%), Jira (24.3%), SQL (23.0%), Postman (22.0%).

Companies with the most open remote QA roles right now are PradeepIT Consulting Services, EUROPEAN DYNAMICS, Keeper Security. Click a company to see its careers page, or browse all remote QA jobs on QA Job Board.

How to get hired at these companies

  1. Match the tool stack. Across all QA job posts, the most requested tools are Selenium (29.9%), Playwright (27.0%), Jira (24.3%), SQL (23.0%), Postman (22.0%). Put the ones you know in your resume headline.
  2. Check the location limits. "Remote" often means remote within one country or time zone. The table shows where each company hires.
  3. Apply early. Remote QA roles get many applicants in the first week. Set up a QA job alert to get new jobs by email.
